10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7c8fb50a-efc7-4b.title: Freelance HR Manager
10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7c8fb50a-efc7-4b.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Voor een van onze klanten zoeken wij een freelance HR Manager. De organisatie groeit snel: van ongeveer 100 medewerkers nu naar circa 200 medewerkers later dit jaar. Ze zitten in midden-Nederland. Om die groei goed te begeleiden, moet HR steviger worden ingericht. De opdracht We zoeken een pragmatische HR Manager voor 12 tot 16 uur per week die helpt om: - structuur aan te brengen; - overzicht te creëren; - één uniforme HR-werkwijze neer te zetten; - HR-processen werkbaar te maken voor alle BV’s; - Nmbrs en Daywize goed in te bedden in de dagelijkse operatie. Het doel is niet om een zwaar corporate HR-model te bouwen. Het doel is een praktisch HR-fundament dat werkt, schaalbaar is en de organisatie helpt groeien. HR is op dit moment centraal belegd voor de hele groep. De huidige situatie - De groep bestaat uit meerdere BV’s. - Er werken nu ongeveer 100 medewerkers. - Dit groeit naar verwachting richting 200 medewerkers. - HR wordt ondersteund met Nmbrs en Daywize. - De basis is aanwezig, maar nog onvoldoende gestructureerd. - Processen zijn nog niet overal uniform. - Er is behoefte aan meer overzicht, vastlegging en duidelijke werkwijzen. De huidige HR-verantwoordelijke heeft hulp nodig bij het aanbrengen van structuur. Zij kan de dagelijkse HR-werkzaamheden oppakken, maar het opzetten van een volledig werkend HR-fundament trekt zij niet alleen. Daarom is er behoefte aan iemand die naast haar gaat staan, prioriteiten stelt en zaken concreet werkend maakt. HR moet meegroeien. Zonder duidelijke structuur ontstaat het risico op: - versnipperde processen; - ad-hoc oplossingen; - te veel afhankelijkheid van losse kennis; - verschillen tussen BV’s; - onvoldoende overzicht voor management en medewerkers. Jij helpt om rust te brengen. Je brengt de huidige HR-situatie in kaart en vertaalt die naar een praktische werkwijze die voor de hele groep werkt. Daarbij help je met: - prioriteiten bepalen; - processen vereenvoudigen; - rollen en verantwoordelijkheden verduidelijken; - Nmbrs en Daywize beter gebruiken; - de huidige HR-verantwoordelijke praktisch ondersteunen; - HR schaalbaar maken voor verdere groei. We zoeken geen theoretisch adviesrapport, maar iemand die bouwt, regelt en implementeert. Concreet betekent dit: - één uniforme HR-werkwijze voor alle BV’s; - duidelijke processen voor instroom, uitstroom en personeelsmutaties; - betere structuur rondom contracten, verlof, verzuim en dossiers; - heldere formats, checklists en werkinstructies; - Nmbrs en Daywize logisch ingericht en goed gebruikt; - meer overzicht in HR-administratie en personeelsinformatie; - betere HR-stuurinformatie voor het management; - een HR-verantwoordelijke die zelfstandig verder kan met de ingerichte structuur. Het einddoel is een HR-organisatie die rust, overzicht en professionaliteit brengt, en die de klant ondersteunt in de volgende groeifase. We zoeken een ervaren HR Manager die praktisch, gestructureerd en daadkrachtig is. Je past goed als je: - snel overzicht creëert; - graag structuur aanbrengt; - processen simpel en werkbaar maakt; - een voorkeur heeft voor hele directe communiatie; - ervaring hebt met groeiende organisaties; - kunt schakelen tussen management en operatie; - iemand praktisch kunt meenemen en ontzorgen; - stevig bent zonder het onnodig ingewikkeld te maken. Je hebt ervaring met: - HR-processen; - personeelsadministratie; - HR-systemen; - contractbeheer; - verzuim; - instroom en uitstroom; - personeelsdossiers; - rapportages en HR-stuurinformatie. Ervaring met Nmbrs en/of Daywize is een sterke pré. We zoeken geen corporate beleidsmaker, maar een pragmatische bouwer. Iemand die ziet wat er nodig is, eigenaarschap neemt en zorgt dat HR werkt voor de hele groep. Iemand die zijn/haar mouwen kan oprollen en zorgt dat het geregeld wordt. Bij 10x verwachten we dat talenten AI-savvy zijn en blijven investeren in hun AI fluency. We zoeken professionals die AI praktisch en verantwoord inzetten binnen hun vakgebied, zodat zij

alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:6d32aa11-a.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:6d32aa11-a.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE Baseten is building the infrastructure layer for AI — and we're now building the team that will scale how we take it to market. This is a foundational hire on our GTM Strategy & Revenue Operations team, sitting at the intersection of strategic planning and field execution. You'll work directly with the CRO, Head of Revenue Operations and partner closely with Finance, field leadership, and our Central Ops team. On any given week, you might be refining our pipeline generation model, building a territory coverage analysis, designing a new GTM motion, or partnering with a regional leader to understand what's driving a trend in their pipeline. This role requires someone who can think rigorously, build things from scratch, and operate with speed and judgment in an environment where the playbook is still being written. This is a rare opportunity to be an early GTM strategy and operations hire at one of the fastest-growing companies in AI infrastructure — and to help define how we scale. WHAT YOU'LL DO: GTM Planning, Target Setting & Market Intelligence - Contribute to the annual and quarterly GTM planning process in partnership with Finance, including headcount modeling, ramp assumptions, and revenue target-setting - Build and maintain coverage models aligned to 2-year growth projections, incorporating territory design, account segmentation, and capacity planning - Support quota framework development, helping translate top-down targets into field-level plans that are credible and motivating - Develop and maintain Baseten's segmentation logic — how we carve the market by industry, company profile, consumption potential, and AI maturity - Contribute a point of view on competitive dynamics, regional expansion priorities, and whitespace opportunities - Partner with Central Ops on ICP and TAM database strategy to ensure segmentation is grounded in clean, enriched data - Translate data into a clear business narrative for leadership and the field; democratize insights so the revenue org can self-serve Pipeline Generation & Forecast - Contribute to the design of the pipeline generation model — coverage ratios, qualified pipeline definitions, and input assumptions - Support the PG cadence: track actuals vs. model, surface gaps early, and partner with field leadership to course-correct - Play an active role in the weekly forecast process, helping build the business narrative that connects leading indicators to revenue outcomes - Build and maintain the analytics layer that powers GTM decision-making — from pipeline dashboards to cohort analyses to efficiency metrics Field Execution & Plan Refinement - Partner with the field to identify gaps in the business and develop structured plans to address them - supporting real time actions as well as insights to guide QBRs, pipeline reviews, etc. - Analyze regional pipeline health, win/loss trends, and rep productivity to proactively surface insights that feed back into refining the GTM plan - Contribute to execution optimization projects — improving the sales process, post-sale journey, and conversion at key funnel stages - Close the loop between what's happening in the field and what needs to change in the plan New Motions & Experimentation - Support the design and execution of structured experiments to test new GTM approaches — new segments, new channels, new acquisition or expansion motions -

ardeapartners-ardea-partners:ashbyhq:dda.title: Vice President - Insurance Services
ardeapartners-ardea-partners:ashbyhq:dda.description: Vice President Duties: Develop and manage client relationships globally across the financial institutions sector, primarily within insurance services and distribution, and closely related insurance brokerage, employee benefits, and insurance technology services businesses. Serve as trusted day-to-day point of contact for clients and partner with senior bankers to advance client dialogues and deliver strategic advice. Lead end-to-end execution of multiple insurance services and distribution transactions, including reviewing valuation and financial analysis, coordinating due diligence, drafting and reviewing marketing and board materials, and managing internal deal teams and external parties. Manage and develop Associates and Analysts, providing ongoing training, mentoring, and performance feedback. Act as a technical subject-matter expert on insurance services and distribution accounting and regulatory topics, as well as on core corporate finance and capital markets concepts. Own delegation, quality control, and risk management for transaction execution and client deliverables by dividing responsibilities and setting timelines, enforcing review gates and ensuring compliant handling of MNPI, conflicts/KYC, and recordkeeping. Champion a culture of excellence, integrity, and collaboration by modeling leadership standards and reinforcing best practices across execution teams. Requirements: Requires Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related field of study, and 4 years of experience as Associate or Analyst involving financial modeling, valuation analysis, transaction execution, due diligence, and preparation of client-facing materials for financial institutions in the investment banking or a related industry. Will accept Master’s degree and 3 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of experience. Experience specified must include 4 years of experience (3 years if Master’s degree) with each of the following: leading financial modeling, valuation, transaction structuring and process-related workstreams across multiple transactions; one or more financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, Capital IQ and SNL, FactSet, PitchBook, or comparable); performing financial analysis and modeling, including building integrated three-statement financial models, discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis, leveraged buyout (LBO) analysis, accretion/dilution analysis, and comparable company and precedent transaction analyses; mergers and acquisitions (M&A), including buy-side and sell-side advisory, divestitures, joint ventures, recapitalizations, management buyouts (MBOs), and leveraged buyouts (LBOs), as well as familiarity with fairness opinions and valuation advisory services; U.S. GAAP, SEC regulations, and investment banking compliance standards; and using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Experience specified must also include 3 years of experience with each of the following: reviewing teasers, confidential information memoranda (CIMs), management presentations, and due diligence materials; managing multiple multi-party transaction processes in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment; mentoring and developing junior bankers; reviewing and providing feedback on financial analyses, models, and presentation materials prepared by junior team members; supporting client relationship management and business development efforts in coordination with senior bankers, including pitch preparation and client communications; and communicating analytical findings and transaction considerations to senior clients and internal stakeholders. Experience specified must include 2 years of experience in the insurance services and distribution industry, including experience with insurance services and distribution business models, regulatory frameworks, key performance metrics and execution of live transactions. Telecommuting permitted up to 1 day per week. Requires up to 20% domestic travel. Employer: Ardea Services

campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:d09ce942-ffa7-.title: VP, Marketing
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:d09ce942-ffa7-.description: ABOUT CAMPFIRE Campfire is the AI-native ERP for high-growth mid-market companies. We automate the work that slows finance teams down — transaction categorization, bank reconciliation, revenue recognition, and reporting — so they can stop building spreadsheets and start driving the business. Our platform includes Core Accounting, Revenue Automation, Ember AI, and our Accounting Intelligence foundation model. We're hiring a VP of Marketing to build the function that takes Campfire to a defining category leader. You'll own the strategy and the execution, stand up the team, and put in place the demand engine that carries us through our next stage of growth. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own marketing strategy end to end: demand generation, pipeline, brand, product marketing, and communications. - Build the demand engine — a repeatable, measurable motion that reliably generates and accelerates pipeline for our sales team. - Recruit, hire, and develop an all-star marketing team, and be the kind of leader that top talent wants to follow. - Partner tightly with Sales and Product to sharpen positioning for a technical, high-consideration buyer and drive efficient growth. - Establish the metrics, systems, and operating rhythm that let marketing scale predictably as we grow. - Tell Campfire's story to the market — sharpening how we talk about a genuinely new category of ERP. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - A track record of building and scaling demand at a high-growth B2B SaaS company — most likely through demand generation, ABM, or integrated marketing, though we're open to strong operators who've come up through other paths. - Experience driving pipeline and revenue in mid-market and lower-enterprise sales motions, with the range to grow deal sizes as we move upmarket. - Proven ability to build a team from the ground up and attract exceptional people. - Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving fast — you're as strong at strategy as you are willing to get into the details and execute. - A rigorous, metrics-driven approach paired with genuine creative instinct for brand and story. NICE TO HAVE - Experience marketing a system-of-record, finance, or back-office platform — it's a plus, but not a requirement. We care more about caliber and drive than category pedigree. WHY NOW Campfire is at the inflection point where the right marketing leader shapes the trajectory of the entire company. If you want a builder's role with real scope, senior-level ownership, and a mission worth doing, this is it.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:6f04dd48-.description: About Gen Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. About You - Curious, analytical, and passionate about solving problems using data, machine learning, AI, and emerging technologies. - Hands-on experience building data-driven applications, analytical solutions, intelligent systems, or AI-powered capabilities. - Familiarity with machine learning, statistical, analytical, or AI techniques. - Strong technical judgment, software development, and problem-solving skills. - Able to independently drive projects from idea to implementation. - Able to evaluate different approaches and make practical technical decisions. - Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams. - Experience developing data-driven applications, algorithms, predictive models, optimization solutions, or similar intelligent capabilities. - Experience working with complex systems, datasets, or production environments. - Contributions to open-source projects, technical communities, hackathons, research initiatives, publications, or personal projects. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8eefcf2a-9bae-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Ruby Developer (Ruby & Go) based in United Kingdom. This is a senior backend engineering opportunity focused on building and scaling secure, reliable payment infrastructure for a global fintech environment. You will take ownership of the backend powering payment portals and integrations with payment service providers. The role combines Ruby on Rails expertise with Go development for high-throughput and latency-sensitive services. You will design end-to-end deposit and withdrawal flows while ensuring robust transaction processing, reconciliation, and failure handling. Security and reliability are central, with a strong focus on financial data protection and compliance. You will also contribute to technical direction, mentor engineers, and help evolve a high-performing international engineering environment. Design, build, maintain, and own backend services using Ruby on Rails and Go, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Lead the integration of new payment service providers and payment methods, including cards, bank transfers, cryptocurrency, and local payment solutions. Build and maintain end-to-end deposit and withdrawal workflows, ensuring secure and consistent movement of funds across the platform. Design, implement, and consume PSP APIs, webhooks, callbacks, and other integration mechanisms. Develop transaction routing, status tracking, reconciliation, and payment lifecycle logic. Implement robust handling for payment states, retries, idempotency, failures, and edge cases to ensure resilient transaction processing. Maintain strong security controls for payment information and support compliance requirements, including PCI DSS. Monitor existing payment provider integrations, troubleshoot issues, and proactively improve reliability and performance. Develop reporting, logging, and observability capabilities that support payment operations and technical troubleshooting. Support the integration of anti-fraud, AML, and KYC controls into payment workflows. Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, technical decision-making, and mentorship of other engineers. Requirements 5+ years of backend engineering experience, particularly in API-driven and integration-heavy environments.
